data.title: Binghatti Elite
data.about:
Binghatti Elite at Dubai Production City (IMPZ) by Binghatti Developers is a premier residential development. The 23-story building offers studios and 1-bedroom apartments designed for modern urban living.

Located in the vibrant hub of IMPZ, Binghatti Elite in Dubai Production City blends contemporary luxury with community-centric tranquility. Flexible Binghatti Elite payment plans present an attractive opportunity for those exploring IMPZ real estate investment and off-plan properties in Dubai Production City.

Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a swimming pool, jacuzzi, kids pool, pool deck, outdoor seating areas, jogging track, basketball court, and kids’ play area. Close to Dubai’s top shopping destinations, this development ensures unparalleled convenience. Explore Binghatti Elite apartments for sale today and become part of an iconic addition to Dubai residential projects by Binghatti Developers.

characteristics_module.title: Binghatti Elite: Where Luxury Living and Prime Investment Opportunities Converge
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse Living Options: The development features a variety of studios and 1-bedroom apartments by Binghatti Developers, catering to different lifestyle needs and preferences.
  • World-Class Amenities: Residents can enjoy luxurious amenities in Binghatti Elite IMPZ, including a swimming pool, fitness centers, meditation areas, and a BBQ deck for relaxation and leisure.
  • Cultural Vibrancy: Living in Binghatti Elite offers a unique blend of a serene community enriched with a vibrant cultural scene that appeals to families and young professionals.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: The Binghatti Elite payment plan is designed for ease. Its 70/30 structure makes it an attractive option for investors looking for off-plan properties in Dubai Production City.
  • Proximity to Shopping and Entertainment: Residents are just minutes away from popular shopping destinations like Dubai Hills Mall and Mall of the Emirates, ensuring a convenient lifestyle.

location_tile.title: Binghatti Elite: Enjoy Living in the Heart of Dubai Production City (IMPZ)
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Elite at Dubai Production City (IMPZ) by Binghatti Developers offers prime connectivity and easy access. Dubai Production City is a dynamic free zone dedicated to the media, production, and entertainment industries, making it a hub for creativity and business innovation. Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, it offers seamless access to Dubai’s key attractions and commercial areas. Residents enjoy proximity to shopping, dining, and entertainment, with City Centre Me'aisem nearby for daily needs. This vibrant location makes Binghatti Elite apartments for sale an ideal IMPZ real estate investment for those seeking convenience and lifestyle.

  • 8 Minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
  • 8 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
  • 10 Minutes to IBN Battuta Mall
  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 10 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 10 Minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 15 Minutes to Expo City Dubai
